name: notebook_edit
description: Edits a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb) safely at the cell level. Use this instead of edit or write_file for notebook cells. Supports replacing, inserting, and deleting cells. Always read the notebook first with read_file; then use the cell IDs shown in that output.

notebook_path.description: Absolute path to the Jupyter notebook file to edit. Must end with .ipynb.

cell_id.description: Target cell ID from read_file output, or cell-N 0-based fallback. Required for replace and delete. For insert, the new cell is inserted after this cell; if omitted, inserted at the beginning.

new_source.description: New source content for replace and insert operations. Not required for delete.

cell_type.description: Cell type for inserted cells or type conversion on replace.

edit_mode.description: Notebook edit operation. Defaults to replace.
